text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Shiori, having finished her work for the day,
finds herself reading through the picture book she received from Hatsune.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その日の仕事を終えたシオリは牧場で、
ハツネから貰った魔物図鑑を読んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
This book really is amazing...
I don't think I'll ever get bored of it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいなぁ……
この図鑑。
ずーっと読めちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
The bookmark is so pretty, too.
And it would be a great fit for other books, too. Especially novels
and the like. If anything, I should just carry it around with me. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
このブックマークも綺麗だし……
他の本にも使おうかな。
図鑑よりも
小説とかの方がいいだろうし
せっかくだし
持ち歩いちゃお♪

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing just how much time and effort Hatsune
put into finding something for me. But that's also
the sort of person she is, so it makes sense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お姉ちゃん、
ずっとプレゼントで悩んでたんだなぁ。
誰かのためにあんなに悩むなんて……
お姉ちゃんらしい……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I still haven't gave her a proper thanks.
Let's write a letter, then. Where did I put my pen and paper...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！
　本のお礼しなくちゃ。
……手紙にしよう。
えっと、
紙とペンは……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I hope a letter's good enough.
Hm? I'm positive I closed the book...
Maybe Rin had a look at it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お姉ちゃん、
喜んでくれるかな。
……あれ？
図鑑が開いてる……
さっき閉じたはずだけど……
リンちゃんかな？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Not that I blame her, considering how good it is.
I should mention that in the letter, too.
Ehehe. I'm not even sure where to start.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい本だもん、
見ちゃうよね。
これも手紙に書いちゃおう……
えへへ、
何から書こうかな。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Hm...? Is it... is it sitting in a different position now?
I was sure I felt fine today,
but I might be more tired than I thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……？
　……気のせいかな、
本の位置が変わってる……？
……今日は体調が良いと思ったけど、
疲れてるのかな？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The next day, {0} arrives at Elizabeth Park for work, 
where Shiori asks him to deliver the letter to Hatsune.
text_block_list.orig_text:
翌日、配達の仕事で【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】を訪れていた
{0}は、シオリから手紙の配達を依頼されていた。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Would you be able to deliver this for me, {0}?
choice_data_list: Is this your way of thanking Hatsune?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん、
これをお姉ちゃんへ届けてほしいんです。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Yes. I just hope it's good enough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
お姉ちゃん、
喜んでくれるといいんですけど。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
I'll take your word for it, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
{0}さんがそう言ってくれるのなら、
きっと
大丈夫ですよね。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, {0}.
I know the letter's in safe hands if it's with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます。
お姉ちゃんへの手紙、
よろしくお願いします。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……スヤスヤ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! Now [i]that[/i] was a good nap! ♪
Energy reserves are officially maxed out!
Wait! How come the sun's setting already?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……っ！
　
はあっ、
よく寝たー♪
元気満タン！
　
って、
も、もう夕方だー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man. I went and slept the whole day awa—
Actually. Isn't that a good thing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
一日のほとんどを寝て過ごしてしまった……
あれ？
　それってすごく幸せなことなんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You betcha it is! I barely had time to nap recently thanks to
all the worrying over Shiorin' present, so it's cool!
Hm? When'd you get here, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ！
　最近シオリンのプレゼント選びでお昼寝もしてなかったし！
たまにはいいよね！
　
……ん？
　あれー
{0}くんがいる。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I really owe you one for your help with Shiorin's present!
Speaking of. Here's the money you lent me! Thanks a lot for that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この間はおかげでシオリンにプレゼントができたよー！
あっ、
これ借りてたお金！
　貸してくれてありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: So what brings you here today?
choice_data_list: I've got a letter for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
今日はどうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
A letter? For me? I wonder who it's from...Oh! It's from Shiorin!
Thanks, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
手紙？
　私に？
　誰だろ……
あー！
　シオリンからだー！
ありがとう{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Let's see here... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: なにかな、なにかな♪

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Dear Hatsune. Thank you very much for your present. Hearing
about how much time you spent looking for something I would
like made me realize just how lucky I am to have a sister like you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんへ、
この間はプレゼント、
本当にありがとう。
お姉ちゃんが私のために
たくさん悩んでくれて、
自分はなんて幸せ者なんだろうって感じました。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Nothing makes me happier than being praised by you,
so getting both that and a present makes 
the effort feel more than worth it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は、
お姉ちゃんに褒めてもらえるのが一番うれしいから、
自分なりに頑張ってきてよかった
って思えたよ。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could do more to thank you than just write a simple letter,
but this was the best I could come up with in the end.
Let's find the time to go somewhere together again. Love, Shiori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お礼として出来るのが、
手紙を書くことくらいしか
思いつかなくてごめんなさい。
また、
一緒におでかけしようね。　
シオリより。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: *sniff, sniff* Waaahhh! Shiorin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぐすっ、
ぐすっ……
うわぁぁぁぁぁん！
　シオリーン！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I'm just... I'm so glad she liked it! I really am!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリンが、喜んでくれて……
よかったよぉぉぉ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, I'm fine!
It's just... Shiorin, she... She really liked my present!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃなくて、
そうじゃなくて……！
シオリンが、喜んでくれたことが、
うれしくて、
うれしくてぇぇぇ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*sob* *sniff* ...Ehehe. S-sorry for crying out of nowhere! ♪
Oh, dear sister of mine! Your letters are ever so potent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっぐ、
……
えへへ、
ご、ごめんね♪
泣いちゃった！
　
シオリンめー、
いい手紙書くなぁー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I gotta write back to her!
Can't let a good letter like this go to waste!
choice_data_list: I'll deliver it for you when you're done.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！
　そうだ！
　お手紙のお返事書かないと！
せっかくシオリンが書いてくれたんだもん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
For realsies?! Ehehe. You're like some sorta mailman
that only delivers happiness, you know that? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当！？　
えへへ、
{0}くんは
私たちに
幸せを運んでくれる
郵便屋さんだね♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Cool, though. I'll get in touch when I'm done!
And thanks for delivering Shiorin's letter!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
手紙ができたらお願いするね！
今日は届けてくれて
本当にありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With a promise made and his deliveries finished for the day,
{0} makes his way back home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネと約束をし、配達を終えた{0}は
帰路へと着くのだった。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Now then! Time to get-a writing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ～し、
書くぞー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day, {0} is back at Elizabeth Park for another delivery.
text_block_list.orig_text:
翌日、{0}は
再び仕事で【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】を訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Hello, {0}.
This is your last delivery for today, I assume?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん。お疲れ様です。
今日の配達は
ここで最後なんですね。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, me? I've just been reading the book Hatsune gave me.
The illustrations move in different ways each time,
so I keep finding myself reading over it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私ですか？
　
今日はお姉ちゃんから貰った図鑑を読んでました。
描かれた魔物の動き方が毎回違うので、
見入ってしまうんです。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
It's certainly going to last me
much longer than most other books. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
普通の本よりも
読むのに時間がかかっちゃいそう♪

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
It's starting to get a bit late, isn't it?
How about you stay the night here, {0}?
Going back to Landosol at this time seems a bit dangerous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん。
今からランドソルに帰るのは危ないと思いますし、
よかったら
今日は泊まっていってください。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else is out today, too, so I was feeling a bit lonely.
So if anything, I'd much rather have someone else around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまたま
今日は私以外出払っていて、
少し寂しかったんです。
なので、
{0}さんがいてくれると、
嬉しいです。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to make use of the guest lounge, then.
I'll join you once I put this book back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ
先に客間へ入っていてください。
私も図鑑を片付けたら、
追いかけます。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
It's starting to get a bit chilly, isn't it?
I should hurry on—
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふぅ
あぅ、
風が冷たくなってきたなぁ。
図鑑、
片付けないと──

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what's going on?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
な、なに！？　
図鑑が──

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Why is the picture book opening itself up?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝手に開いた……？
　どうして……！？

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: GRRAAAAAGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Monsters?! But where did they—
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物！？
　そんな──

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: GRRAAAAAGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Hatsune...!
text_block_list.orig_text: お姉ちゃん──！
